Step 3: Expand the squared absolute values into algebraic expressions.
Expanding the squared absolute values, we get $(25+20i-z)(25-20i-z)=25$ and $(z-4-k)(\overline{z-4-k})=(z-3i-k)(\overline{z-3i-k})$.
